title: Strategy & Operations Coach APAC
description:
About The Role

We are looking for senior leaders in strategy & operations roles who value learning, growth, and community and who are passionate about developing and coaching people in their field.

We are specifically looking for coaches who have experience in Singapore or Hong Kong serving the SEA region, or experience in market including Japan, India, South Korea, and Australia.

As a Mento coach, you will form 1:1 partnerships with our members to help them identify & track clear goals, become a better leader, communicate more effectively, problem solve issues at work, and help them feel happy, fulfilled, and engaged at work and beyond.

All Mento coaches, regardless of coaching experience, are required to participate in our ICF-certified coach training program to learn Mentoâs coaching methodology prior to working with our members. Our coach training is an immersive, transformational training designed to help you grow as a coach, master the Mento Coaching Methodology, and gain access to proprietary tools that set our coaches apart. This program is ICF-certified, and participants who successfully graduate will earn Continuing Coach Education Units. If youâre ready to elevate your coaching skills, deepen your impact, and become part of a groundbreaking coaching team, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your journey!

Your routine responsibilities will include:

  • Providing 1:1 coaching to Mento members through virtual sessions using the Mento Platform and Tools

  • Participating in ongoing training sessions to improve coaching abilities and skills

  • Communicating with members via your Mento email or via chat in the Mento App in between sessions

  • Being an integral member of the Mento coaching community by sharing coaching tools and insights â helping enhance our coaching practices and fulfill our mission of empowering people to thrive in jobs that they love

  • Acting with kindness, respect, and empathy as an ambassador of the Mento community

Who are you?

You areâ¦

  • A director, vice president, or other senior strategy & operations leader with 20+ years experience managing strategy & ops teams and coaching individuals (coaching certification is a plus but not required).

  • Someone who wants to turn their people leadership skills into meaningful coaching skills.

  • Passionate about helping people advance in the workplace to build fulfilling careers and lives.

  • A person who is self aware, who has a high emotional IQ, and who cares about creating a safe space for others to risk being vulnerable.

  • Excited about growing your coaching skills, and you bring a growth-mindset to the experience, regardless of how long you have been a coach.

  • Comfortable working in a constantly-changing startup environment.

  • Able to dedicate a minimum of 12+ hours per month to coaching at Mento for the next 24+ months.

At Mento, we invite new coaches to join us on a rolling basis. The time frame on which we add new coaches is based on the particular needs of our clients and their teams. While we may not need to add an Operations & Strategy VP Coach today, we would still be very excited for you to get in touch with us now if this opportunity resonates with you.

Other details

  • This is a contract position in which coaches are paid per hour. On top of a flat hourly rate, we offer select bonuses that incentivizes engagement with our membership and community growth on our platform

  • You must have the capacity to give a minimum of three to five hours per week towards Mento regardless of other commitments and how they may change.

  • You are able to work with Mento for a minimum of 24 months in order to build meaningful relationships with our members.

  • This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be based in North America or Europe.

  • Because this is a part-time growth opportunity, we are looking to hire experienced senior leaders who want to expand their coaching skills.

Our Hiring Philosophy:
All new Mento coaches are required to participate and graduate from our ICF certified coach training program: Mento Coaching 101. This training is rigorous, and our goal is that all participants are able to be matched with members soon after they complete it. We want to make sure that we are both setting our coaches up for success and respecting everyoneâs time. Therefore, we hire based on incoming member demand. While we are constantly looking and interviewing for the best coaches to join our team, we will only send offers to candidates for whom we have an immediate need. Candidates who receive a YES from Mento after the interview process will either be sent an offer to join the next monthly Coaching 101 training or be added to our coach shortlist to join us when the demand is there.

Inclusion Statement:
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Research shows that candidates from unrepresented backgrounds may not apply to jobs unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the requirements.

title: UI Developer
description:
RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional Jr. UI Developer.

 

About RainFocus

RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun and exciting. 

 

About the Role

As a Jr. UI Developer, you will be an essential part of our team, assisting in the implementation of stunning, user-friendly web applications. Working alongside experienced developers, you will use HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript to help translate designs into high-quality web experiences for our events and platforms. This position is ideal for an early-career developer who is passionate about visually-focused development, eager to learn best practices in CSS and JavaScript, and excited to collaborate within a supportive team environment. You will gain hands-on experience with branding, workflows, and enterprise-grade software development.

\n


How you will contribute:

  • Assist in developing, updating, and maintaining UI components and branding with a strong focus on design and responsiveness.

  • Collaborate closely with senior developers, designers, and Product Management to learn processes and deliver quality work.

  • Write clean, maintainable HTML, CSS (using SASS and utility classes), and basic JavaScript (including exposure to React and Svelte).

  • Help troubleshoot, debug, and fix styling issues or UI-related bugs across different browsers and devices.

  • Participate in code reviews to receive feedback, learn RainFocus coding standards, and improve your skills.

  • Support the team in configuring client white-labeling, templates, and basic event workflows.


Required Experience/ Skills:

  • 1â2 years of professional web development experience, or equivalent experience through bootcamps, internships, or robust portfolio projects.

  • Solid fundamental knowledge of HTML, CSS, and CSS preprocessors like SASS.

  • Basic understanding of vanilla JavaScript and an eagerness to learn modern frameworks like React and Svelte.

  • Understanding of responsive design principles and cross-browser compatibility.

  • Familiarity with version control systems, such as Git.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • A proactive mindset, self-motivated to ask questions, learn, and grow as a developer.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Works well in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  • Exposure to design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or Photoshop.

  • Basic awareness of web accessibility (WCAG) standards.

  • Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies.

  • General understanding of how APIs or backend systems (like Java) interact with front-end code.


\n

Why work at RainFocus?

At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.

 

As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities. 

 

What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!

title: Customer Support Services Fiduciary Agent
description:
About Jimdo

We exist to unleash the power of the self-employed - helping solopreneurs and micro-businesses thrive by doing what they're passionate about and removing the complexity of building lasting, successful businesses.

Jimdo started in 2007 when three school friends built a website builder in a Northern German farmhouse to help everyone build a presence online. Today, we're a profitable, remote-first company with 220+ people from 50+ nationalities working across 15+ countries. We've helped build over 36 million websites to get online across the world.

We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward.

At the heart of Jimdo is a strong belief in personalized, data-driven guidance. Our platform combines design, business tools, and an AI-powered core that turns real customer data into clear insights and next steps helping our customers focus on what moves their business forward.

Role Overview :

This role starts with a strong foundation in day-to-day customer support. You will begin by handling regular customer inquiries to build deep knowledge of our products, customer journeys, tools, and internal workflows. This phase is essential for understanding real customer needs, common friction points, and how our systems work end to end.

As you gain confidence and context, the role evolves into a highly specialized CSS Fiduciary Agent position. You will take ownership of our most complex and sensitive customer cases, including billing, payments, contracts, disputes, and exceptional commercial situations. Acting with fiduciary responsibility, you’ll make thoughtful, fair, and compliant decisions that balance the customer’s best interest with long-term company sustainability.

Beyond resolving individual cases, you will look for root causes behind recurring issues, proactively guide customers toward better outcomes, and feed insights back into product and process improvements. Your work directly strengthens customer trust, improves retention, and reduces future customer friction by ensuring issues are solved correctly and responsibly at their root.

Your impact:

  • Start in hands-on customer support to learn our products, customer journeys, and internal workflows.

  • Take ownership of complex cases across billing, payments, contracts, refunds, and disputes.

  • Own customer interactions end to end, ensuring accurate resolutions and high-quality documentation.

  • Apply sound judgment in fiduciary decisions, including commercial cases.

  • Identify recurring issues and share actionable insights to help prevent future customer problems.

  • Proactively engage customers to guide outcomes, build trust, and support retention.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to continuously improve service quality and decision-making.

  • Help shape a hybrid customer experience where human judgment and AI work together effectively.

What you bring:

  • 3+ years in Customer Support, Success, or similar roles

  • Proven experience with payments, billing, or financial processes

  • Experience in SaaS, fintech, or high-volume environments

  • Strong sense of ownership, sound judgment, and a customer-first mindset.

  • Comfort working in ambiguous situations and handling sensitive or regulated topics responsibly.

  • Experience with support and collaboration tools such as Zendesk, billing systems, Google Workspace, and Slack.

  • Bonus: Fluency in German or French.

What we offer:

Inspiring Mission: At our core, we are driven by a meaningful mission - to empower solopreneurs and small businesses to succeed and to contribute to the sustainability and vibrancy of the communities they serve.

Flexibility and Trust: Our work environment thrives on flexibility and trust. We offer fully remote work set-up with opportunities for in-person collaboration.

An International Diverse Team: Our team is a mosaic of over 248 individuals hailing from 50+ different countries and working across 15+ diverse locations. We take pride in our openness and inclusivity.

Continuous Growth and Career Development: We invest in your growth with company-wide access to LinkedIn Learning and curated learning paths. From day one, you have the chance to contribute your ideas and create a meaningful impact. Our flat hierarchies and swift decision-making processes provide an open platform for your career progression.

Competitive Benefits Package:

  • Annual compensation reviews to ensure you're rewarded fairly.

  • A remote office set-up bonus to enhance your workspace.

  • An employee assistance program, offering resources and counseling.

  • Plus, a perk that keeps giving: up to three free Jimdo websites for your personal or professional projects that you get to keep forever.

Jimdo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. This means that we don’t discriminate based on race or ethnic origin, color, the language(s) you speak, where you (or your parents) are from, or whether or not you consider yourself to have a disability. Neither will your age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, beliefs, or political opinions play a part in your application with us. Our diverse team values and celebrates the uniqueness of each individual. We embrace differences and believe that they enrich our organization, making us stronger and more innovative. Join us, and let's continue to create a workplace where everyone can thrive, regardless of background or identity.

Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.

What We Do...

Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.

That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.

You will have the chance to learn about the challenges that accommodation providers face, and offer a solution that will bring value to their day-to-day and bottom line. title: Industrial Data & Solutions Engineer (gn) @ Stealth AI Venture, Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio company.

What we're building

Factories run on machines that generate huge amounts of data, and almost none of it gets used. We're changing that. We build AI software that helps production engineers and operators turn machine data into answers: why a line is slowing down, what's causing scrap, and what to fix next. We're early and in stealth. Our two founders both held C-level roles at leading German robotics ventures. They have spent years bringing advanced technology onto real shop floors, and now they're hiring the founding core team.

Your role & responsibility

You're the person who makes our product work in the real world. You go into a plant, figure out what's actually broken, connect the data, and stay until operators use the product every day without being asked. You'll work with everyone from the machine operator to the plant manager, and with IT and OT. You own each customer from the first conversation through rollout and expansion. Berlin or home-based in Germany, with regular time in Berlin with the team. You'll spend about 20% of your time at customer sites.

What you'll do

  • Own deployments end to end: use-case definition, data onboarding, validation, rollout, training, and adoption

  • Turn messy production problems into clear data, analytics, and solution requirements

  • Onboard and validate machine, process, quality, and maintenance data from industrial systems

  • Spot data problems that only make sense if you understand the machine behind them

  • Build and validate KPIs, features, anomaly signals, calibration methods, and analytical workflows in Python and SQL, using statistics and time-series analysis

  • Run the project with the customer and our commercial lead: plans, workshops, validation sessions, and success criteria

  • Find the next machine, line, data source, or use case, and expand with it

  • Bring what you learn in the field back to the product, so each deployment makes the platform better

  • Help write the playbook for how we deliver, as the customer engineering team grows

You might be a fit if you

  • Have worked hands-on with industrial machines and production processes, in manufacturing, automation, maintenance, quality, industrial engineering, or industrial data

  • Know your way around PLCs, SCADA, MES, historians, production databases, quality systems, or OPC UA

  • Use Python and SQL to answer questions, not just to write code

  • Have worked with time-series data, KPIs, anomaly detection, or root-cause analysis

  • Communicate as well on the shop floor as in the plant manager's office

  • Like solving hard problems in automation and process engineering

  • Take ownership, work independently, and are comfortable when things are ambiguous

  • Are happy to travel to customer sites and have a driver's license

  • Speak fluent German and English

A degree is optional. A Meister, Techniker, vocational training, or real-world experience counts just as much. We care about what you can do.

We're open to experienced people who can lead deployments on their own, and to exceptional earlier-career people with strong industrial experience who learn fast.

This is not a desk job. It's hands-on and customer-facing, and you'll spend a lot of your time where the machines are.

Why now

You'll be one of the first people in the company. You'll work directly with the founders and shape how we deliver to customers from day one. What you build here becomes the way we work. We'll tell you more about the company, the founders, and our backers in the first conversation.

description:
About BlockTech

BlockTech is an algorithmic trading firm headquartered in Amsterdam, with a second office in Singapore. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets.

We’re looking for a AI Quantitative Research Intern to join our researchers and traders in Amsterdam. You'll join our option pricing team and work alongside experienced Quantitative Researchers, Traders and Analysts, with a dedicated mentor guiding your project.

What will you do?

You’ll have the opportunity to help shape an emerging field, taking ownership of designing and improving our agent-driven research framework. You’ll have the freedom to explore new approaches, pioneer solutions, and make a meaningful impact on how we conduct research.

You will:

  • Architect our agent-driven research framework, designing networks of agents and harnesses.

  • Design research pipelines and experimentation loops with quants and traders.

  • Build evaluation and feedback mechanisms that show what’s working and what isn’t.

  • Own the framework in use: track how it performs and keep improving it.

  • Share what you learn, so the team keeps improving its AI setup.

What we’re looking for

You’ll need:

  • To have a background in a highly quantitative field, with a focus on AI (MSc or PhD)

  • At least 6 months of practical experience with LLMs, agents, and harnesses.

  • Comfort designing evaluation and feedback loops that tell you whether an agent is actually improving.

  • High ownership and clear communication.

  • Availability to start in (early) 2027, full-time and on-site in Amsterdam, for a minimum of 12 weeks.

Nice to have

  • Experience using AI for quantitative research, such as working on math problems.

  • Python, and exposure to trading.

Dates, location, and accommodation

  • Duration: From 12 to 16 weeks, with flexible duration and start date.

  • Location: On-site at our Amsterdam office.

  • After the internship: the opportunity to convert into a full-time role after graduation, based on performance.

What else is in it for you

  • A dedicated mentor and a great team of colleagues to learn from.

  • An in-house training program and a close look at how engineering, research, and trading work together.

  • An environment that embraces AI, both to speed up your work and to advance our systems.

  • Sports during working hours: kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer.

  • Weekly Friday drinks and other celebrations.

  • Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and soft drinks all day.

How we work

We're a team of trading and tech enthusiasts with a flat hierarchy. Have an idea today, and it can ship tomorrow. The best idea wins, whoever it comes from.

You'll be challenged from day one, with a mentor and diverse team around you. We promote reverse leadership, give everyone an equal playing field, and invest in personal and professional development.

Excited to join us?

Make your move and apply! You can expect to hear back from us within 5 working days.


Our culture

At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals.

In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities.

We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. Our commitment to personal development transcends traditional norms; we provide an equal playing field, promote reverse leadership, and offer boundless growth opportunities for all our employees.

Join us to unlock your potential and drive innovation in the exciting world of algorithmic trading.

title: Integration Test Engineer
description:
Role - Integration Test Engineer

Company - iwell - Harmonizing Clean Energy

Location - Utrecht

About iwell

At iwell, we are all about reinforcing energy security. We help European businesses become more energy independent. With growing regulations, extreme price volatility and rising grid issues, they need to be resilient. It is time to take charge and think ahead. We deliver energy management solutions that ensure that businesses are always in control of their energy. Our in-house developed EMS and modular battery storage drive profit through sustainability, making businesses future-proof. 

We are a fast-growing international team of driven and collaborative talents, from engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. No matter what your strong suit is, we always are looking for people who are determined to make a positive impact: iwell is committed to form a diverse and inclusive team to tackle the challenges of the energy transition.  

The Role

The proof is in the pudding, they say in the UK, however, we believe proof is in the test data. All our systems and their interactions within the larger energy ecosystem are thoroughly tested. We are serving a diverse customer base with strict demands, our services power business and key infrastructure. We demand that our products are subjected to a wide range of testing during the integration and development phase. We're seeking a talented and curious test engineer with a passion for sustainability and battery energy storage. 

You will handle a wide variety of topics from different customer requirements and have a lot of freedom to develop the test methodology and strategy. You will work within the battery system team, where software and hardware come together in the products we develop for our customers.  We will rely on your experience, hands-on approach and judgment. You will be crucial in driving our mission of transitioning from fossil-fuel dependence. If you're passionate about sustainability and have the technical skills to bring our vision to life, we want to hear from you.

What you will do

  • Develop test campaigns based on internal and external requirements

  • Discuss and present test results internally and externally

  • Execute tests and document the result

  • Support the integration of hardware components into iwell’s BESS, ensuring compatibility and performance.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, such as system specifications,  processes, and instructions.

  • You will become one of the practical system experts within iwell, interacting with field service, product development and engineering teams.

What are looking for

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering (HBO/WO) or equivalent experience.

  • Experience in electrical design of high power and energy conversion systems.

  • Knowledge of technical standards and grid operator connection requirements.

  • Able to make the basic design for a site with energy production and storage, feeding into the Medium Voltage AC grid, including cable system design, PE system design and according to national installation guidelines.

  • Strong communication skills and attention to quality assurance

  • Ability to read and produce technical drawings and schematics

  • Ability to speak and write German is a plus

Note: at iwell, we value growth potential over perfection. Feel free to respond if you can see yourself meeting this list in the (near) future.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary within the range of EUR 5,200 - 5,800 (plus 8% holiday allowance)

  • 30 holidays per year, plus an annual company trip of 3 days

  • The opportunity to do volunteer work, by offering 1 volunteer day per year

  • Learning & Development budget of EUR 1,500 per year 

  • Attractive pension plan with Brand New Day 

  • Working remotely for 2 weeks per year 

  • We cover your travel costs, regardless of whether you come by bike, car, or public transport.

  • A mobile phone allowance of EUR 25 per month

  • Additional activities such as a bootcamp, volleyball tournament, company drinks etc.

  • iwell is a family friendly company and employs many employees with care-taking responsibilities

Interested?

For more information about iwell, what we do, why we do it, and an overview of our partners, visit https://iwell.eu/. 

Our application process

  1. Apply. Our People & Culture Team and the hiring manager will review your application and will respond within 2 weeks.

  2. Phone screening. Are you an iweller-in-the-making? We will invite you for an introductory call.

  3. Are you the one? You will have two or more interviews. For some roles, you will also be asked to work on a case.

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to land and expand n8n inside the world’s largest organisations, closing the biggest deals in our portfolio.

As a Large Enterprise Account Executive covering Nordics & Benelux, you will own a territory of global-scale accounts and lead long, complex deals from first conversation to multi-year commitment:

BUILD STRATEGIC ACCOUNT PLANS

  • Build and execute account strategies for organisations with 5,001 or more employees

  • Open doors with outbound campaigns aimed at CTOs, CIOs and engineering and platform leaders.

  • Turn community adoption inside large companies into sponsored, funded opportunities.

LEAD COMPLEX, MULTI-THREADED DEALS

  • Run deep discovery, quantify business impact and build an executive-level business case.

  • Map and align decision makers across engineering, IT, security, legal and procurement.

  • Partner with Solutions Engineers, Partnerships and Customer Success to prove value and de-risk adoption.

CLOSE AND EXPAND AT SCALE

  • Own the cycle through security, legal and procurement, typically over three to six months or more.

  • Negotiate six-figure deals with confidence and keep clear commercial control.

  • Plan expansion across business units and use cases, and share what you learn with Product and leadership.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🏢 Large Enterprise sales: You have at least five years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, selling into organisations with 5,001 or more employees, and you can explain customer size, deal complexity and cycle length.

  • 💰 Six-figure deals: You have closed multiple deals of £100k+ ACV in multi-stakeholder cycles of three to six months or more.

  • 🧑‍💻 Technical buyers and executives: You have sold to developers, engineers, CTOs and CIOs, and you can carry a technical conversation and an executive one in the same deal.

  • 🎯 New-logo hunter: You generate your own pipeline through outbound and win new customers rather than relying on expansion or inbound.

  • 📈 Track record: You have consistently hit or exceeded quota over the past two to three years.

  • 🧭 Structured selling: You use a methodology such as MEDDPICC and navigate technical evaluations, procurement, legal and security reviews.

  • 📍 Location: You are based in the Nordics / Benelux. This role involves regular travel to customers in the region.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🛠️ Technical product background: You have sold developer tools, cloud infrastructure, data, AI or automation platforms.

  • 🤝 Partner-led deals: You have worked deals with system integrators or cloud partners.

  • 🚀 Open source or PLG exposure: You understand how community adoption turns into enterprise revenue.

Why join us?

You will close the largest deals in our portfolio and shape how n8n sells to the world’s biggest organisations, with a product technical teams already use and love. You will work closely with Solutions Engineers, Partnerships, Customer Success and Product, and leadership will listen to what you learn in the field. n8n is growing at an exceptional pace, backed by a vibrant community and a remote-first culture built on autonomy, experimentation and high talent density. Apply now and help us bring AI-powered automation to the global enterprise.

title: Implementation Specialist
description:
I quit medicine because I kept watching patients die needlessly, for avoidable reasons. In almost every case, the medical knowledge and clinicians were there. It was the system that failed: the way information moved, decisions got routed, and fragmented teams and data turned solvable problems into tragedy.

I started Anima to change that.

Our mission is human wellbeing, and we believe personalised medicine will transform it. Our founding insight is that getting there requires a system that learns continuously from care and its outcomes, optimising for human wellbeing. Building that learning engine is the opportunity at the heart of Anima.

We're now in 1,000+ clinics across 5 product lines, serving more than 25% of the UK population. We are cash flow positive, growing fast, and have a tight crew of ~45 people who care deeply for each other and the mission. Everyone has real ownership and a voice in decisions.

Multiple trillion-dollar companies will be built in healthcare over the next two decades. We intend to be one of them.

If you want to work on problems where the stakes are high, you belong at Anima. Your work here will save lives.

-- Shun

£65k–£90k base, plus equity
UK remote, UK working hours, with occasional UK customer visits

The role

Help GP practices make a confident start with Anima.

Last quarter, we onboarded 131 practices. We’re building a dedicated Implementation team to support that growth, and you’ll be one of its first members.

You’ll own each implementation from kick-off through go-live and early support, helping practice teams build the skills and confidence to use Anima independently. You’ll also help shape how we implement: improving workflows, developing training and building a playbook that works across hundreds of practices.

What you’ll do

  • Own implementations from start to finish. Coordinate kick-off, configuration and go-live, aiming to get most practices live within their first week.

  • Make Anima work for each practice. Understand how their team operates and configure workflows around their needs.

  • Teach people to use it confidently. Run clear, practical training for clinicians and practice teams, adapting your approach to different levels of technical confidence.

  • Build confidence beyond go-live. Develop practice super users, provide 1–2 weeks of hypercare and hand over cleanly to Support and Customer Success.

  • Make great implementation repeatable. Create reusable training and group webinars. Use feedback from customers, Support and CS to solve recurring problems at their source.

What you’ll bring

  • SaaS experience. You’ve worked directly with customers on a SaaS product in onboarding, implementation or training.

  • Strong teaching and communication skills. You can make something unfamiliar feel manageable and check that people can put it into practice.

  • Patience and adaptability. You respond thoughtfully when someone is struggling or their priorities change.

  • Practical problem-solving. You learn products quickly and can work out why a workflow isn’t delivering the intended result.

  • Ownership and organisation. You can keep several implementations moving while making the next steps clear to everyone involved.

Healthcare experience isn’t required—we’ll help you learn primary care. Experience creating training videos, guides or webinars would be useful.

What we offer

Anima should be where you do your life’s best work. We support that with:

  • Time off: 25 days’ annual leave plus 8 UK public holidays, with flexible additional time off.

  • Health cover: private medical, dental, vision and mental health insurance.

  • Parental leave: 12 weeks’ maternity leave at full pay, rising to 24 weeks after two years; 4 weeks’ paternity leave at full pay.

  • Pension: 4% employer contributions, with salary sacrifice and 100% of the employer National Insurance savings passed on to you.

  • Learning: £1,000 annual budget for your development.

  • Fitness: gym subscription matching up to £50 per month.

  • Equipment: a high-spec MacBook and a home office budget.

  • Time together: two full-team off-sites each year, previous destinations include Mykonos and Mexico.

  • Farringdon office: a beautiful new London HQ, with most of the team together at least twice a week.

Everyone is welcome at Anima. We strongly believe in building a diverse and inclusive team. If you’re excited by our mission and believe you could do this work well, we’d love to hear from you, even if your experience doesn’t match every point above. If adjustments would help you participate fully in the interview process, please let us know.

title: Customer Support Operations
description:
I quit medicine because I kept watching patients die needlessly, for avoidable reasons. In almost every case, the medical knowledge and clinicians were there. It was the system that failed: the way information moved, decisions got routed, and fragmented teams and data turned solvable problems into tragedy.

I started Anima to change that.

Our mission is human wellbeing, and we believe personalised medicine will transform it. Our founding insight is that getting there requires a system that learns continuously from care and its outcomes, optimising for human wellbeing. Building that learning engine is the opportunity at the heart of Anima.

We're now in 1,000+ clinics across 5 product lines, serving more than 25% of the UK population. We are cash flow positive, growing fast, and have a tight crew of ~45 people who care deeply for each other and the mission. Everyone has real ownership and a voice in decisions.

Multiple trillion-dollar companies will be built in healthcare over the next two decades. We intend to be one of them.

If you want to work on problems where the stakes are high, you belong at Anima. Your work here will save lives.

-- Shun

£25k–£75k base, depending on location and experience, plus equity
Remote, UK time zone

The role

When a clinic gets stuck, you’ll help them move forward. You’ll become an expert in Anima, untangle technical problems and give clinicians and practice teams clear, practical answers.

This is a hands-on IC role with real ownership of how support develops at Anima. You’ll resolve customer issues while helping build the function: deciding what to measure, improving how the team works and shaping what excellent support looks like as we scale.

What you’ll do

  • Own issues through to resolution. Support customers through Intercom, email and short video calls. Investigate thoroughly, keep people informed and follow through.

  • Make technical problems actionable. Reproduce bugs and give engineers clear steps, relevant logs and customer impact. Help distinguish product issues from gaps in understanding or setup.

  • Make answers easier to find. Turn useful solutions into Help Centre articles, internal guidance and short walkthroughs.

  • Build the support function. Identify what’s holding the team back and own improvements—from how we measure quality and prioritise work to the systems, playbooks and automations we use. Test new approaches, see whether they work and help the whole team improve.

  • Bring customer insight into the business. Help Product understand where users struggle, and work with Implementation and Customer Success when an issue needs broader attention.

Success means customers get accurate answers quickly, issues reach a clear resolution, and the team gets better at preventing or handling the next one.

What you’ll bring

  • Practical problem-solving. Evidence of getting to the bottom of unfamiliar problems, testing possible explanations and finding a workable solution.

  • Clear, empathetic communication. The ability to explain a complicated issue simply, adapt to different levels of technical confidence and build trust with frustrated customers.

  • High agency and drive. Examples of improving a process or building something useful—and seeing it through.

  • Reliability under pressure. Good judgement about urgency, careful follow-through and the ability to manage several conversations without losing track.

  • Curiosity about how products work. An appetite for learning Anima in depth and working closely with engineers to resolve problems.

Relevant experience could come from customer support, technical operations, implementation or another role involving complex products and direct customer interaction. Experience with support platforms or process automation is useful; your judgement and results matter more than familiarity

What we offer

Anima should be where you do your life’s best work. We support that with:

  • Time off: 25 days’ annual leave plus 8 UK public holidays, with flexible additional time off.

  • Health cover: private medical, dental, vision and mental health insurance.

  • Parental leave: 12 weeks’ maternity leave at full pay, rising to 24 weeks after two years; 4 weeks’ paternity leave at full pay.

  • Pension: 4% employer contributions, with salary sacrifice and 100% of the employer National Insurance savings passed on to you.

  • Learning: £1,000 annual budget for your development.

  • Fitness: gym subscription matching up to £50 per month.

  • Equipment: a high-spec MacBook and a home office budget.

  • Time together: two full-team off-sites each year, previous destinations include Mykonos and Mexico.

  • Farringdon office: a beautiful new London HQ, with most of the team together at least twice a week.

Everyone is welcome at Anima. We strongly believe in building a diverse and inclusive team. If you’re excited by our mission and believe you could do this work well, we’d love to hear from you, even if your experience doesn’t match every point above. If adjustments would help you participate fully in the interview process, please let us know.

title: Enterprise Account Executive (Europe)
description:
About Valdera:

At Valdera, we empower innovators to turn ideas into reality by transforming how manufacturers source materials. We make it effortless for companies to find the best materials and suppliers for their needs, enabling them to build high-quality products at scale and deliver them to millions of consumers worldwide.

We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with a proven track record of working with Fortune 500 industrial manufacturers, beauty brands, and chemical companies. We are a fast-growing company that hires talented, hardworking people who excel in high-performance environments and want to grow their careers quickly.

Our culture is built for exceptional individuals to take on meaningful challenges, collaborate with the top minds in our industry, and see the direct impact of their work. If you’re looking for a fast-paced environment where your ideas will drive real change, Valdera is the place for you.

Join us, and let’s shape the future of manufacturing together.

About the Role:

We are looking for a seasoned Enterprise Account Executive to lead our expansion in the European market. In this role, you will be responsible for navigating complex, multi-threaded sales cycles with some of the largest chemical and manufacturing enterprises in the region.

You will act as a strategic partner to procurement leaders and supply chain executives, helping them modernize their sourcing operations through Valdera’s cutting-edge technology. This is a high-impact role for a consultative seller who understands the intricacies of industrial supply chains and can navigate large organizations to close significant deals.

Role Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close for large enterprise accounts across Europe, with a specific focus on the industrial hubs within the DACH region.
  • Navigate complex organizations by building consensus across multiple stakeholders, including CPO (Chief Procurement Officers), R&D heads, Supply Chain leads, and IT/Digital Transformation directors.
  • Go beyond transactional sales; diagnose deep-seated supply chain inefficiencies and present Valdera as a strategic solution for resilience, cost savings, and speed-to-market.
  • Act as the "boots on the ground" for our European expansion, providing feedback to Product and Leadership teams on regional market nuances, regulatory requirements (e.g., REACH), and customer needs.
  • Rigorously manage your pipeline and forecast with accuracy, ensuring a consistent flow of new business opportunities.
  • Proactively iterate on and improve Valdera’s sales playbook and process, including lead generation, discovery, follow-up messaging, negotiations, and closing strategies.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Professional Experience: 5–10 years of total working experience.
  • Sales Expertise: A minimum of 5 years of closing experience in enterprise sales (Global 2000), specifically managing multi-threaded deals with average contract values (ACV) that require executive-level sign-off.
  • English: Native or professional fluency is required.
  • German: Business fluency is highly preferred to effectively manage relationships with key stakeholders in the DACH region.
  • Highly Desirable: Experience selling into the Chemicals, Manufacturing, or Supply Chain/Procurement sectors. You understand the language of BOMs, RFQs, and raw material sourcing.
  • Acceptable: A strong background in Management Consulting (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, BCG) focused on operations/supply chain, combined with proven sales experience.
  • Enterprise DNA: You have experience navigating the bureaucracy of large enterprises and have the patience and grit to drive deals to completion.
  • Location: Remote within Europe. Living in the DACH region is preferred.

Characteristics that Win

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You genuinely want to understand how things are made and the chemistry behind the products we use every day.
  • High Agency: You don’t wait for a playbook; you see a problem, and you solve it. You are comfortable working with ambiguity in a high-growth startup environment.
  • Consultative Mindset: You don't just sell software; you sell a transformation in how companies operate.
  • Builder Mentality: You love building a business and shaping processes; you don’t wait for it to show up.

Compensation

Additional Information

Why Join Valdera?

Ownership: Founding member of our European GTM team with significant autonomy. Opportunity to grow into Sales Management.

Impact: We are not just optimizing clicks; we are fixing the physical supply chain that the world relies on.

Growth: Work alongside a world-class team from top tech and industrial backgrounds in an environment that prioritizes rapid career acceleration.a

Salary Range:

Salary ranges are determined by multiple factors, including the labor market, market compensation bands, internal parity, and budget considerations. The final offer will be based on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, location, and experience relative to the role's requirements. We will make a compelling offer for the right candidate.

Benefits:

Valdera offers generous benefits to employees. Full-time employees are eligible for premium healthcare, dental, and vision insurance coverage. You will be provided with a more detailed breakdown of your options before joining Valdera.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:

Valdera is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and celebrate a culture that values varied perspectives, skills, and experiences. We are dedicated to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination, where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute.

Please note that Valdera uses E-Verify to confirm the identity and employment eligibility of all new hires.

title: Anaesthetic (Pain) Consultant
description:
At Montu UK, we are passionate about improving the lives of patients who have often exhausted conventional treatment options. Through our Alternaleaf clinic, we are helping people living with chronic and debilitating conditions access treatments that can make a genuine difference to their quality of life.

We are looking for Consultant Anaesthetists who are interested in exploring the growing field of medical cannabis and developing their expertise in chronic pain management.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing healthcare organisation, working alongside a multidisciplinary team of experienced clinicians who share a passion for improving patient outcomes.

With a fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management and comprehensive specialist training, we are keen to hear from consultants who are open to exploring new approaches to patient care and want to make a meaningful difference in an evolving area of medicine.

Previous chronic pain experience is not essential. What matters is a genuine interest in learning, an open-minded approach to alternative treatment options and a commitment to delivering excellent patient care.

What is the job?

As a Consultant Anaesthetist at Montu, the role focuses on assessing and supporting patients living with chronic pain who may have exhausted conventional treatment options.

Working within our Alternaleaf clinic, consultants play a central role in determining the suitability of cannabis-based prescription medicines (CBPMs), developing individualised treatment plans and supporting patients throughout their treatment journey.

The position offers the opportunity to build on existing expertise in analgesic pharmacology, pain management and opioid stewardship while developing specialist knowledge in an evolving area of medicine.

Our multidisciplinary approach brings together consultants, nurses, pharmacists and other healthcare professionals, allowing consultants to focus on clinical assessment, prescribing decisions and ongoing patient care.

Sponsored Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management

As part of our commitment to clinical development, Montu is offering a fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management through the University of South Wales, delivered fully online in partnership with Learna.

The programme provides an opportunity to develop specialist knowledge in chronic pain management while continuing to gain practical clinical experience within our multidisciplinary team.

About the diploma

  • A 12-month, part-time postgraduate diploma with all teaching and assessment completed online.

  • Focuses on interdisciplinary and multidisciplinary pain management, assessment and service provision.

  • Full course fees funded by Montu UK.

  • Two hours of protected, paid study time each week.

Further information about the programme is available through the University of South Wales.

Eligibility

  • A minimum working commitment of 24 hours per week with Montu.

  • Two of those hours each week are allocated as protected, paid study time.

  • Continued employment with Montu at a minimum of 24 hours per week for the duration of the diploma.

What will you be doing?

  • Providing high-quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment for chronic pain and other qualifying conditions.

  • Conducting patient consultations, including clinical assessments, prescribing decisions and ongoing patient management.

  • Applying anaesthetic expertise in analgesic pharmacology, drug interactions and opioid stewardship to support safe prescribing.

  • Reviewing patient progress and treatment effectiveness, making adjustments where clinically appropriate.

  • Engaging in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence-based practice.

  • Contributing to clinical governance and maintaining robust patient care standards.

  • Collaborating with a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists.

  • Completing the sponsored Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management alongside clinical responsibilities.

  • Participating in ongoing training and professional development, including specialist training in cannabis-based prescription medicines.

What you need

  • Full GMC registration with a current licence to practise.

  • Completion of specialist training in Anaesthesia (CCT/CCST) or equivalent.

  • Entry on the GMC Specialist Register for Anaesthesia.

  • Strong knowledge of analgesic pharmacology, pain management and safe prescribing.

  • Excellent communication skills and a patient-centred approach to care.

  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a multidisciplinary clinical team.

  • A strong interest in chronic pain and alternative treatment options.

  • Willingness to participate in clinical outcome data collection and reporting.

  • Ability to commit to a minimum of 24 hours per week for the duration of the diploma.

Previous chronic pain experience is welcome but not essential, as the sponsored diploma and comprehensive in-house training will support professional development.

Why join us?

  • Competitive Salary: £170,000 FTE, pro rata for contracted hours.

  • Funded Postgraduate Diploma: Full course fees for the Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management, plus two hours of protected, paid study time each week.

  • Flexible Working: Fully remote working with flexible clinical sessions and a minimum commitment of 24 hours per week.

  • Comprehensive Indemnity Coverage: Montu covers all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for work undertaken within the role.

  • Work-Life Balance: No night shifts or on-call requirements.

  • Specialist Training: Access to CPD-accredited medical cannabis education and specialist training from experienced clinicians.

  • Collaborative Environment: Work alongside a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals.

  • Professional Development: Build expertise in chronic pain management and contribute to an evolving area of medicine.

Training & Development

  • Fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management through the University of South Wales.

  • Regular CPD sessions to support ongoing professional development, appraisal and revalidation.

  • Specialist training delivered by experts, including Prof Anup Mathew (Consultant Psychiatrist) and Dr Gerard Sinovich (Pain Management Consultant).

  • Ongoing support and training in clinical protocols, prescribing practices and Montu's clinical systems.

  • Appraisal and revalidation support where Montu is the main employer.

Working arrangements

  • Remote Role: Fully remote working with flexibility around working days and hours.

  • Weekly Commitment: A minimum of 24 hours per week, consisting of 22 hours of clinical work and two hours of protected, paid study time.

  • Sessions: Standard clinical sessions consist of four hours of patient consultations, with flexibility to arrange sessions around preferred working days and hours.

  • Appointment Durations: 15 minutes for new and existing patients.

  • Multidisciplinary Support: Nurses and pharmacists support pre-consultation and follow-up prescribing tasks, allowing consultants to focus on clinical assessment, prescribing and patient care.

Our multidisciplinary model enables consultants to focus on their clinical expertise while benefiting from the support of an experienced wider healthcare team.

What we offer

  • Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year two) + 8 bank holidays

  • Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

  • Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, and more

  • Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

  • Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

Postgraduate Diploma Sponsorship Terms and Conditions

As Montu is fully funding the Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management, sponsorship is subject to a separate training agreement.

  • A minimum commitment of 24 hours per week is required throughout the diploma programme.

  • Two hours each week are allocated as protected, paid study time.

  • Continued employment with Montu at a minimum of 24 hours per week is required for the duration of the diploma.

  • If employment ends before completing the diploma or within 12 months of completion, repayment of the course fees will be required.

Full repayment terms will be outlined in a separate training agreement, which must be reviewed and signed before enrolment.

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

You will not be able to complete our screening task if you are not based in the UK, so please bear this in mind when submitting your application. We hope to welcome you to the team soon!

Join Anima, and you'll use your influence and people skills to get Anima into clinics and entire regions: an urgently needed product that saves lives amid critical levels of patient demand, with healthcare systems in crisis across the globe.

Since launching in the UK, we're now used in by GP practices, primary care networks and federations across the country who collectively provide care for over 2 million patients.

Have amazing stakeholder conversations with users who fanatically love the product, and steer our product direction

Our current distribution team have said that one of the biggest perks of working at Anima is seeing the delight and disbelief on people’s faces when we show them our demo, something that is truly a 10x generational leap. Here’s what some of our users have been saying:

*“I sent a plan to the patient and it’s incredible, within a few minutes they’re coming back to me saying that they can make the appointment!”

"I would call that next generation, I think you have that badge"

”Sometimes you need to stop driving a Fiesta and buy a Mercedes"*

Lots of us went into medicine because we wanted to maximise our positive impact. At Anima, we understand that distribution is the other half of a legendary product. Here are incredible things we’ve built as a result of our fullstack sales team:

  • A Clinical Director at one of our practices wanted to streamline multiple access channels and make access equitable and fair. After some great discovery and deep listening, the AM together with the customer suggested we build something called ‘proxy requests’, which would allow the reception team at a clinic to complete Anima requests on behalf of a patient who was on a landline call - this made it possible to give someone with no internet or mobile phone the same access to care. This is now one of our most popular features that has led to viral referrals and fanatical users.

  • One of our fullstack account manager, realised that adding a configurable feature that allows patients to self-book appointments directly into the electronic health record calendar would be critical to closing large enterprise accounts. By deeply understanding the pain points and anxieties underlying the feature, Anima built the feature in 9 days, to the great excitement of users at demo calls and $1m+ ACV meetings.

  • Off the back of fanatical referrals from our existing users, the team was invited to present to NHS England at national and regional level, and we’ve been helping to shape the future of the primary care market through an upcoming $1bn+ procurement framework.

Does this sound like you?

  • Hungry and wants their shot to change the world - a force of nature when empowered with the tools, resources and development to do it.

  • Exceptional communicator, able to distill complex information into clear and concise bullets without jargon. An excellent conduit between users and the rest of the company.

  • Able to execute a high sigma discovery process and in combination with incisive people intuition, elucidate deep pain points and opportunities to excite within minutes of the first call.

  • Has incredibly high standards for themselves and an unshakeable growth mindset: able to challenge themselves and those around them to push to do things better.

  • Exceptionally organised: able to build & maintain multiple relationships across a diverse range of organisations, and consistently execute on plans to onboard and retain users. Reliably follows up on 100% of qualified leads at optimal intervals.

  • A gifted relationship builder, able to quickly build rapport and emotional anchors with almost anyone and any persona.

  • Pragmatic rather than dogmatic in decision making: able to weigh real world data appropriately, changing course when necessary towards optimal outcomes for patients and clinicians.

  • Keen to understand the big picture & entire context of the company and vertical; impatient to grow towards a senior executive role.

  • Seeks to maximise combined team productivity, communicating the right things at the right time through the right channels.

  • Intellectually curious and loves learning - able to tackle entirely novel challenges that lack prior precedent through first principles thinking, creatively using the right pragmatic approach, with an understanding of alternatives and trade offs.

We’ll also be identifying international partners to power Anima’s next stage of growth.

title: Intercompany Accountant
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We are looking for an Intercompany Accountant to support the Group's intercompany accounting processes across our international group, with a focus on cost-plus calculations, intercompany reconciliations, and period-end close.

This is a hands-on accounting role suited to someone who enjoys working with detailed financial data and resolving discrepancies. The role works closely with local finance teams and other Group Finance stakeholders across entities and time zones.

The role is responsible for the accurate, complete, and timely delivery of assigned intercompany accounting activities, from source-data validation and cost-plus calculations through posting, reconciliation, issue resolution, and close support. The position operates within approved accounting policies, intercompany agreements, methodologies, and control requirements, escalating material or unusual matters to the Intercompany Manager.

Work Location: Hybrid (Netherlands or United Kingdom) | Remote (other European countries)

Your responsibilities will include:

Cost-plus calculations and agreement support

  • Prepare end-to-end cost-plus calculations in accordance with approved intercompany agreements, methodologies, and mark-up rates.
  • Extract and validate cost data, identify eligible costs, and apply agreed allocation keys, exclusions, and mark-ups.
  • Maintain detailed calculation schedules, ensuring traceability to source accounting records and supporting documentation.
  • Calculate periodic intercompany charges and true-ups, and prepare the related journal entries for review and approval.
  • Coordinate with local finance teams to confirm cost inputs and ensure timely recording of charges by both counterparties.
  • Reconcile calculated charges to invoiced and recorded amounts, investigate differences, and prepare proposed corrections.
  • Support the maintenance of documentation required to evidence the application of approved intercompany agreements and cost-plus methodologies.

Reconciliations and discrepancy follow-up

  • Help with monthly intercompany profit-and-loss reconciliations and quarterly balance-sheet reconciliations using NetSuite reports and established templates.
  • Match transactions and balances between group entities by counterparty and currency.
  • Investigate differences arising from timing, foreign exchange, missing entries, incorrect coding, or other posting issues.
  • Follow up with local finance teams to obtain supporting information and track outstanding items through resolution.
  • Prepare proposed correcting entries for review and post approved adjustments.
  • Identify recurring mismatch patterns and communicate root causes and practical remediation actions to the Intercompany Manager.

Period-end close and reporting

  • Complete assigned intercompany close activities within agreed deadlines and in line with the Group close calendar.
  • Keep reconciliation trackers up to date, clearly documenting unresolved differences, follow-up actions, owners, and dependencies.
  • Provide clear explanations and supporting evidence for external audits, internal reviews, and other finance queries.
  • Communicate potential close risks early when required inputs, confirmations, or corrections are not received on time.

SOX and internal controls

  • Prepare and document a defined sub-set of the FSCP-REP control series related to intercompany processes

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of experience in accounting, preferably intercompany accounting or general ledger within an international or multi-entity organisation.
  • Practical experience preparing cost allocations, intercompany recharges, or cost-plus calculations is an advantage.
  • Strong Excel skills, including lookups and pivot tables.
  • Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP system; NetSuite experience is an advantage.
  • A degree or equivalent qualification in accounting, finance, or a related discipline.
  • Strong written and spoken English for communication with international finance teams.
  • Strong understanding of journal entries, account reconciliations, foreign currency (FX), and month-end close processes.
  • Ability to work confidently with large financial datasets, identify patterns in reconciliation differences, and document clear root-cause analysis.
  • Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to repetitive, deadline-driven accounting work.
  • Comfort working in a fast-changing, international and post-IPO environment where processes and responsibilities may evolve as the Group grows.
  • A collaborative approach and willingness to support colleagues across entities and time zones.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Utilization Management Nurse RN
description:
Overview

Who We Are

Because health is personal. That's why Personify Health created the first and only personalized health platform—bringing health plan administration, holistic wellbeing solutions, and comprehensive care navigation together in one place. We serve employers, health plans, and health systems with data-driven solutions that reduce costs while actually improving health outcomes. Together, our team is on a mission to empower people to lead healthier lives.

Learn even more about the work that drives us at personifyhealth.com.

Responsibilities

Ready to make the right call on care, fast, fairly, and by the book?

Why This Role Matters

Every day, members and providers are waiting on a decision that shapes what care happens next. As a Utilization Management Nurse, you’re the clinical expert who gets it right. You’ll review requests against plan language, medical policies, and evidence-based criteria, then deliver timely, compliant determinations that protect both member access and appropriate use of resources. When a case needs a deeper look, you’ll route it to the Medical Director and support appeals with clear, complete clinical summaries. Your documentation keeps us audit-ready under NCQA and URAC standards. When you deliver accurate, on-time decisions, members get the care they need and the organization earns the trust that keeps our programs strong.

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time, with rotating Saturday coverage as required.

What You’ll Actually Do

  • Decide with clinical rigor: Perform medical-necessity reviews and level-of-care determinations using benefit language, plan documents, medical policies, and nationally recognized evidence-based criteria such as MCG (and NCCN as applicable), in line with state and federal requirements.
  • Apply criteria consistently: Hold to policy every time, and when a request doesn’t meet criteria, route it promptly to the Medical Director for secondary clinical review and potential adverse determination per UM policy and accreditation standards.
  • Dig into the documentation: Analyze clinical records for completeness, spot risk and acuity indicators, flag inconsistencies or missing information, and start outreach or escalation right away per UM workflow.
  • Prioritize what can’t wait: Organize your workload around urgency, regulatory and accreditation time frames, and potential member impact, and raise barriers early so determinations stay timely and compliant.
  • Steer care in-network: Confirm eligibility, benefits, authorization requirements, and network status to support benefit-compliant redirection when it’s clinically appropriate.
  • Power the appeals process: Prepare clinical summaries and supporting documentation, coordinate peer-to-peer and Medical Director discussions when indicated, and route cases on time per policy, including Independent Review Organization (IRO) processes when required.
  • Document with precision: Record reviews, rationale, criteria and policy citations, communications, and outcomes accurately and in real time in designated UM systems to support quality oversight, reporting, and audit readiness.
  • Hit the standard: Meet productivity, quality, accuracy, and turnaround-time expectations, take part in calibration and quality activities, and put feedback to work in your daily practice.
  • Protect member privacy: Maintain HIPAA compliance and confidentiality using minimum-necessary standards, and complete required training and annual competencies by their deadlines.
  • Back up the team: Cross-train and provide cross-coverage to keep operations running and service-level commitments met.

Qualifications

What You Bring to Our Team

Education & Experience:

  • Current, unrestricted RN license in the United States or a U.S. territory (compact license acceptable where applicable)
  • Graduate of an accredited nursing program (ADN or diploma required; BSN preferred)
  • Minimum 1–2 years of recent clinical experience in acute care, med-surg, ICU/ED, or another relevant setting
  • Prior utilization review or utilization management experience preferred

Technical Skills:

  • Ability to interpret medical records and apply evidence-based criteria and plan medical policies, with appropriate escalation to the Medical Director for non-certifications
  • Working knowledge of MCG, NCCN (as applicable), NCQA and URAC standards, and HIPAA requirements
  • Knowledge of medical claims and ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook
  • Basic computer literacy, proficient typing, and the ability to work across multiple screens
  • Ability to work independently within UM systems and programs after training

Benefits

The Highlights:

  • Competitive base salary and benefits effective day one
  • Comprehensive medical and dental through our own health solutions (yes, we use what we build)
  • Paid Time Off—rest and recharge time is non-negotiable
  • Mental health support, retirement planning, and financial protection
  • Professional development with clear career progression and learning budgets
  • Mission-driven culture where diverse perspectives drive real impact on people's health

Want the full picture? Visit personifyhealthbenefits.com to explore our complete benefits package, wellness programs, and other employee perks.

Compensation: This position offers a base salary range of $35.00-$38.00 per hour, depending on location, skills, and experience. You're eligible for our full benefits package starting day one.

Our Commitment: Personify Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We cultivate a work environment where differences are celebrated, and employees of all backgrounds are empowered to thrive—because diversity is core to who we are and critical to our work in health and wellbeing.

Stay Safe: Personify Health will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information like social security numbers during hiring. All official communication comes from verified company email addresses and or our secure applicant tracking system. Suspicious requests? Report them to . View all legitimate openings at personifyhealth.com/careers.

  • Nice to have: experience selling services.

What We Offer:

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development.

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect.

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters.

At Staples, we're transforming how healthcare organizations manage critical print and document solutions. As the Senior Manager, Print Operations, you will lead a specialized team responsible for evaluating, planning, and supporting complex healthcare print and document management opportunities. This high-impact leadership role combines operations, strategy, financial analysis, and cross-functional collaboration to help drive profitable growth while ensuring operational excellence, data integrity, and regulatory compliance. If you're a strategic thinker who thrives on solving complex business challenges and building scalable solutions, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact across the organization.

  • Oversee opportunity assessments and translate customer requirements into operational workflows, implementation plans, and service models.
  • Direct financial modeling, customer profitability analysis, pricing strategies, and cost evaluations that support business decisions and competitive proposals.

  • Establish governance processes for client file intake, data validation, documentation standards, and operational controls.

  • Support onboarding and implementation activities by identifying risks, dependencies, resource requirements, and success measures.

What you bring to the table:

  • Strong strategic and operational leadership skills with the ability to align business opportunities to organizational goals.
  • Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a focus on operational and financial performance.
  • Expertise in financial modeling, pricing analysis, profitability assessment, and business case development.
  • Ability to evaluate complex operational requirements and design scalable business solutions.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to influence and build consensus among diverse stakeholders.

  • Experience leading process improvement and change management initiatives.

What's needed - Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Operations Management, Business, Finance, Analytics, Supply Chain, Information Management, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in print operations, document management, business operations, financial analysis, pricing, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated success evaluating complex business opportunities and developing operational and financial recommendations.

  • Experience with financial modeling, pricing strategies, profitability analysis, cost analysis, and KPI development.

We are currently looking for QA testers to join our testing community.
